replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Sometimes yes! When faced with complex proofs or unfamiliar equations, my mind gets foggy due to years of struggle without the right support systems. The anxiety often stems from feeling overwhelmed by gaps in my understanding.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, but I’ve heard about tools like *Wolfram Alpha* or Duolingo’s math modules. They simplify explanations and offer interactive problems, making tricky concepts feel less intimidating—almost like a tutor with patience.

It’s about breaking it into logical steps—no magic here!

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: 1) Standardize your data (mean=0, variance=1). 2) Compute covariance matrix and find eigenvectors with largest eigenvalues. 3) Project data onto these axes to reduce dimensions.
